tasks.final_text: Recently I went to a dorm event, where Trancos hosted an outdoor-themed speaker. He was this guy who, after high school, decided to walk across the US (it took him about a year), so in his talk, he talked a bit about that experience, and how the most important part to him was the variety of people he met. He has since become a river guide.

Tower 333 is a 20-story high-rise office building in the central business district of Bellevue, Washington, United States. The building housed the corporate office of Expedia, Inc. from 2008 to 2019. Amazon is planned to take over the lease for the entire building in 2020.
